title: Fillet Both Sides
goal: A practitioner can read the fillet both sides artefact at a glance.

rubric.must: A visible AWS reference line, arrow, and weld symbol identify the joint.
The symbol placement visibly distinguishes the specified weld side or both sides.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG more clearly connects the welding symbol to the actual joint and shows both-side fillet symbols directly on the reference line.
